card.fact_statement: The Bureau of Fire Protection was commanded to assist evacuation efforts during the 2025 Philippine monsoon floods.
card.source_span: He also commanded the Philippine National Police and the Bureau of Fire Protection to assist the evacuation efforts.

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年のフィリピンのモンスーン洪水の際、避難活動を支援するよう命じられた機関はどれですか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: He also commanded the Philippine National Police and the Bureau of Fire Protection to assist the evacuation efforts.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Bureau of Fire Protection is translated as 消防局.
